name: OpenGothic
description:
OpenGothic is an open-source reimplementation of the classic 2001 action-RPG Gothic 1 engine. Written in modern C++ with Vulkan rendering, it modernizes the living, breathing dark fantasy world of the Colony.

Features:
- Hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering pipeline with dynamic lighting and shadows
- Modern high-resolution and widescreen display support with adjustable FOV
- Modernized combat controls, camera handling, and gamepad integration
- Improved simulation stability and pathfinding for NPC routines
- Requires original Gothic 1 game assets to play
